purpose: User-authorized focused S3 revision and first exploratory comparison with unchanged ordinary BLNN; no report requested.
status: NO_DRIVE board preflight only; new motion not yet released
priorData: Five complete F5 run01 records preserved. One each, not repeated causal or superiority evidence; ordinary motion has one missing tick, five-way comparison uses399 common motion timestamps without interpolation.
motivatingClue: S3 return-start translation prediction often has sigma*dhat<0 and is sector-limited; mixed geometry constraints globally freeze the error update. This motivates bounded repair but does not prove the sole cause of the tracking gap.

mechanism.eligible: CA only; nonzero geometry constraint mask; no amplitude or speed bit and no hard-clip reason; raw prediction*sigma<0; pre-gate>nominal learn.
mechanism.proposal: min(pre-gate,0.99*[-(1-dt*gamma*0.01)*raw]/[dt*gamma*sigma*sum(feature^2)]); retain existing weight bounds and error-update/leak formula.
mechanism.accept: Actual projected candidate prediction computed with unchanged features and summation order is finite, same sign (zero allowed) and abs(new)<=abs(old). Commit weights only after this check.
mechanism.reject: No candidate weight is committed; original weights undergo leak-only legacy update. This leak-only fallback is not claimed to satisfy an extra floating-point contraction theorem.
mechanism.growth: No node growth on accepted or rejected repair cycles; ordinary and non-repair growth rules unchanged.
mechanism.limits: Local same-feature property only, not stability, future-state generalization or superiority proof. Corrective requests in other globally constrained modes retain the old rule.

probe.noDrive: Task never arms, always CAN_cmd_3508(0,0); CAN sender also unconditionally forces M1=M2=0. Secure unloaded mechanism independently: zero current is not a holding brake.
probe.cases: 3000 old/new ordinary and3000 same-state old/new S3 pairs;4,59-growth,60 nodes; pure-rate,mixed,wrong-direction repair,amplitude andbrake fixtures. Reference and candidate kernels run on alternating cycles.
probe.screen: I3..8 new optimized peak bins all<600us, I60 body<1000us, I58 remaining stack>=1024bytes; zero fault/overrun/late/communication errors. I93 old-kernel reference peak not the600us target. Finite fixture coverage, not WCET or motion qualification.
probe.save: All107 channels; retain5sec after completion, normally I0>=20sec. E5T6_S3R1_HW6_NO_DRIVE_run01.csv in00_静止测速.

pairedMotionAfterProbeReview.sameCondition: No added mass, same2mm trajectory and limits; clean history and fresh4-node zero-weight reset each. Record battery voltage and CAN/current/temperature health; no charging while moving.
pairedMotionAfterProbeReview.save: I2=6,I22=0 then keep receiving until I88=4423,I89=4 and retain5sec (normally I0>=100sec). Export all107 channels. Do not clear, reset or stop export at phase6 alone.
pairedMotionAfterProbeReview.onFault: Stop safely and preserve/export same history at least5sec after fault, no automatic retry/overwrite. Include failures, no success-only selection.
